results_seen_before_this_preregistration.interpretation: Recent monitor improvement is encouraging but not replicated strongly enough on the single pre-monitor inner block. Temporal replication is required before candidate freeze.

rolling_fold_contract.positive_event_units_used_for_score_repl: last 80 chronological positive units before monitor
rolling_fold_contract.fit: all earlier eligible units before the calibration block
rolling_fold_contract.quiet_units: hardened contiguous negative blocks, max seven days, broken by events and long gaps
rolling_fold_contract.purge_boundary: strictly greater than 24 hours at fit/calibration/threshold/score boundaries

model_contract.direct_calibration: logit intercept fit only on calibration role
model_contract.late_fusion_stacker: L2 logistic regression C=1.0 on calibration-role component logits only
model_contract.threshold_selection: maximum TSS on threshold role with lowest-threshold tie break

evaluation.pooled_score_decision: concatenate disjoint fold score rows using each fold's frozen threshold

candidate_rule: LATE_FUSION_SOLAR_XRS is eligible for candidate freeze only if its median fold TSS difference versus BASE_SOLAR is positive, its pooled TSS difference is positive, and the pooled paired 95% bootstrap interval does not support a clear harmful effect. A strictly positive pooled lower confidence bound is preferred but not required for development continuation. Monitor results are not part of this rule.
forbidden: 2023-2025 monitor rows in fitting, calibration, thresholding, or rolling-fold selection
